description: Stefan Herrnleben and colleagues at the University of Würzburg publish 326,157 cellular-network measurements collected in Germany between August 2021 and June 2023. The November 2023 Zenodo record provides measurements.json freely under CC BY 4.0. Collection used cars, bicycles and walking, concentrated on rural areas and primarily measured the Telefónica/o2 network. The observations can help characterise mobile service conditions or calibrate coverage assumptions in communication-infrastructure simulations. The public description leaves specific measured fields, units, sampling intervals and spatial completeness unknown. The collection should not be treated as a balanced comparison of all German operators or as current national coverage. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this measurement campaign. The JSON file was not downloaded, so coordinate conventions, missingness and repeated-location sampling were not independently checked.
